cases.title: React request race
cases.solution: Cancel stale requests with AbortController and check sequence numbers.

cases.title: Vue reactivity refs
cases.solution: Use toRefs to retain reactive bindings when destructuring Vue state.

cases.title: SQLAlchemy N+1 queries
cases.problem: Loading related records issues many queries
cases.solution: Use selectinload for related collections and verify query counts.

cases.title: Python timezone aware dates
cases.problem: Naive timestamps cannot compare with UTC timestamps
cases.solution: Store timezone aware datetime values with UTC.

cases.title: 列表分页请求竞态
cases.problem: 快速切换分页后旧结果覆盖新结果
cases.solution: 通过递增请求序号忽略过期响应，确保仅更新最新分页结果。
